about: bank 0 $A800-$AFFF: the Executor pictures of the intro and the wave transitions, the score ladder and wave status display, the lazar ground splash, the shield gauge and glow, and the training manual's script opcodes and first six scripts

B0:A843.name: exec_slide_in
B0:A843.desc: draws the Executor (the star destroyer picture at $298E in the pseudo ROM) coming in from the right near the end of the asteroid wave. nothing is drawn until PH_TIM reaches 260 (360 when GM_DIF is 2 or more), then the picture goes at y 200, x 530 - 7 * frames since then, at scale $7400. called by the view LA5F9. Y-->VG list

B0:A881.name: exec_slide_on
B0:A881.desc: draws the Executor at y 200, x 250 - 7 * the low byte of PH_TIM, at scale $7400: the continuation of exec_slide_in in the phase that follows (view LA63E), starting where that one stopped. Y-->VG list

B0:A8F8.name: exec_drift_left
B0:A8F8.desc: draws the Executor at the screen position VWDTHB saved in $4CCE (y) and $4CCC (x), after moving x 16 to the left. called every frame by the view LA599, whose phase (L707A) ends when x has reached -520. Y-->VG list

B0:A91A.name: vew_exec_intro
B0:A91A.desc: the whole view of the phase L6999, 100 frames before a game: message $2C (DARTH VADER'S EXECUTOR IS SEARCHING FOR THE REBEL HIDEOUT) in red, the Executor picture ($2B70 in the pseudo ROM) crossing the screen from x 700 leftwards 10 a frame, and the stars. after frame 60 the brightness of the text, the ship and the stars (ST_BRT) falls by 3 a frame

B0:A96C.name: vw_score_all
B0:A96C.desc: the score and status display that nearly every view calls first: vw_score_ladder then vw_wave_left. takes the place of Star Wars' VWMES. saves X and U. Y-->VG list

B0:A976.name: vw_score_ladder
B0:A976.desc: shows the scores at the top left, much changed from the first half of Star Wars' VWMES: in red the high score entry the player has yet to beat with its rank ($4C72) and the top score with rank 1, in green the player's own rank and score with a flashing box round it, and in yellow the amount last added while SC_ADT runs (that part is Star Wars'). all lines use 8 digits and sit further left when the top score or the player's score has reached 1,000,000. Y-->VG list

B0:AB26.name: vw_wave_left
B0:AB26.desc: shows the right hand status: WAVE (message $0E) and the BCD wave number, left out while Jedi letters are held and their display is on, then a count of interrupts since the last call drawn beyond the right screen limit, and for the probot, walker and TIE fighter waves the number of enemies still to shoot ($4C53) followed by its name from enemy_name_msg. the number flashes red and white for 16 frames whenever it changes. Y-->VG list

B0:ABF5.name: lz_ground_hit
B0:ABF5.desc: tests whether the lazar is sweeping the ground and sets up the splash. a point $4000 ahead at half the lazar's screen position goes through the matrix processor (MS_PSUB, scratch block), and if the resulting z is below zero or below half the player's height $509C while LZ_ON, LZ_HIT is set with splash type 3, a colour (white, or purple while the Jedi force is on) and SP_LOC from the high byte of z. made from the first half of Star Wars' GRLZIN

B0:ACC4.name: vw_gas_jedi
B0:ACC4.desc: the views' entry to the shield gauge. while a hit is being animated (GS_HIT) it draws the gauge part of VWGAS, with the Jedi force timer $4C50 at zero it is VWGAS, and while the force is on it draws nothing, except that in the last $60 counts VWGAS blinks back in whenever bit 3 of the timer is set. Y-->VG list

B0:AE22.name: man_op_nop
B0:AE22.desc: training manual script opcode 6 and above: does nothing. reached through man_op_tab from the interpreter LB189

B0:AE23.name: man_op_end
B0:AE23.desc: training manual script opcode 0, the last record of every script: sets $4CB8 to $FF, which makes L7542 leave the page, and turns all messages off. reached through man_op_tab

B0:AE2C.name: man_op_messon
B0:AE2C.desc: training manual script opcode 1: turns on the message whose number is byte 4 of the record (MESSON). U-->record. reached through man_op_tab

B0:AE33.name: man_op_messoff
B0:AE33.desc: training manual script opcode 2: turns off the message whose number is byte 4 of the record (LCB21, the MESSOFF entry). U-->record. reached through man_op_tab

B0:AE3A.name: man_op_poke_b
B0:AE3A.desc: training manual script opcode 3: stores byte 4 of the record at the RAM address in bytes 5-6. the scripts use it to set the first byte of an object record. U-->record. reached through man_op_tab

B0:AE43.name: man_op_poke_w
B0:AE43.desc: training manual script opcode 4: stores the word in bytes 3-4 of the record at the RAM address in bytes 5-6. no script uses it. U-->record. reached through man_op_tab

B0:AE4C.name: man_op_call
B0:AE4C.desc: training manual script opcode 5: calls the routine whose address is in bytes 3-4 of the record (LB14E, LB1CF, LB1D6, LB1E7, LB1EE, LB1FC, which is why the tracer found no caller for those) and keeps U. reached through man_op_tab

LB189 runs at most one record a frame from the pointer $4CB6, so records with the same time run on successive frames. 488C.name: gs_fade
488C.desc: brightness of the shield segment just lost: DO1GAS sets $F0, VWGAS takes 8 off each frame and ends the loss (GS_HIT, GS_GLW cleared) at zero. the IRQ puts it in the colour instruction at $002E in vector RAM

488D.name: sc_wide
488D.desc: non-zero when the top high score or the player's score has its top two digits in use: vw_score_ladder then shows 8 digit scores and moves the lines and the box left

4B42.name: hs_top
4B42.desc: the top high score, 4 BCD bytes: the score field of the first 7 byte entry of INITLS (3 initials, 4 score bytes)

4BFB.name: bcd_lo
4BFB.desc: BCD+2, the low byte (two digits) of BINBCD's result

4C19.name: left_flash
4C19.desc: flash timer of the enemies-left number: $7F when the count changes, down by 8 a frame, the number alternates red and white while it runs

4C4A.name: wave_bcd
4C4A.desc: the wave number shown after WAVE, BCD (GM_DWAV in Star Wars): 1 at power up, the starting difficulty + 1 when a game begins

4C50.name: jedi_tim
4C50.desc: word, with a fraction byte at $4C52: Jedi force time left. set to $01C0 when the fourth letter is earned and counted down by P1_95F1, zero when the force is off. under $60 the purple colours and the shield gauge blink on its bit 3

4C53.name: bonus_left
4C53.desc: probots, walkers or TIE fighters still to shoot in this wave: preset when the wave starts, one off for each kill, at zero the wave's Jedi letter is awarded (P1_9573). shown with the enemy's name by vw_wave_left

4C54.name: left_shown
4C54.desc: the value of $4C53 that vw_wave_left last showed, to start the flash when it changes

4C72.name: hs_next
4C72.desc: index (0 = top) of the high score entry the player's score has yet to beat: 24, the last of the 25, at game start, stepped down by KE209 as the score passes entries, -1 when the player leads

4C80.name: jedi_let
4C80.desc: Jedi letters earned, one bit each in bits 0-3, $0F when JEDI is complete

4C82.name: jedi_show
4C82.desc: state of the Jedi letter display: 0 off, 1 a newly earned letter is being presented, 2 the letters are shown

4C84.name: jedi_on
4C84.desc: set by P1_9645 each frame while the Jedi force timer runs or a new letter is being presented: stars and lazar splash turn purple

4CAC.name: ph_tim_lo
4CAC.desc: PH_TIM+1, the low byte of the phase timer

4CB8.name: man_done
4CB8.desc: $FF when the training manual script has reached its end record (man_op_end), cleared by PHINXT. L7542 leaves the page when it is set

4CBA.name: sc_add_top
4CBA.desc: SC_ADD-1: the top two digits of the amount last added to the score, which is shown as 8 digits from here

4CCC.name: exec_x
4CCC.desc: word: screen x of the Executor, saved by VWDTHB from its projected centre and moved left by exec_drift_left. L707A ends its phase when it is down to -520

4CCE.name: exec_y
4CCE.desc: word: screen y of the Executor, saved by VWDTHB for exec_drift_left

509C.name: ply_z
509C.desc: word in math RAM: the player's height, third of the position words $5098/$509A/$509C. the wave setups preset it ($0200 probots, $0800 walkers, $1800), S1MVBS adds the vertical movement and copies it to MS_TZ+M_U1

questions: B0:AE54-B0E3: the script records mix fields (word time, opcode byte, then a message number, a value and RAM address, or a code address) so no region kind fits them. bytes 3-4 of the opcode 5 records are code addresses (LB14E at AF37 AF8F AFE7, LB1CF at AE97, LB1D6 at AEC7, LB1E7 at AF6F, LB1EE at AFA7, LB1FC at B04F) and bytes 5-6 of the opcode 3 records are RAM addresses ($49D2, $49E6, $4A54)

B0:B169 is outside this chunk but the task asked for it: 16 pointers, first four to the per-section lists LB171/LB177/LB17D/LB183 inside the same table, then twelve script addresses (LAE54 .. LB0C4). the interpreter there also uses $4CB5 (manual page 0-2) and $4CB6 (word, pointer to the next script record), which i left for the owner of $B000 to name

B0:AB6F: SWNEW ($48CC) is not the switch edge catcher in the game - the IRQ increments it at LEAA5 and vw_wave_left shows it as a number at x 560, past VGLIMR, and clears it. it looks like a development readout of interrupts per frame left in, but i could not confirm that it is invisible on the real monitor

B0:AB60 the carried comment HILITE SELECTED LETTER, B0:AB34 6 DIGITS WITH COMMAS, B0:ABC0 YELLOW FOR THE SITE and the DETH STAR comments at B0:A897-A89C and B0:AAAA-AAD2 belong to other Star Wars code and do not describe these lines: AB34 shows message $0E WAVE, ABC0 is the x position 288, A897/A89C are the scale $7400 and the JSRL to the Executor picture, AAAA-AAD2 draw the flashing box round the player's score

the header note of VWGAS (B0:ACD8) is Star Wars' and names TGCLR, VJFUEL, GSVNEW and GSVALL, none of which exist here: the ESB routine draws one segment picture per shield on each side from shield_segs_left/right in a colour from shield_colors, fades the lost segment, then the word SHIELDS and the number. i left the description alone and commented the lines
$4801 is used here as plain scratch (brightness in vew_exec_intro, loop count in VWGAS) and already has seven Atari temp aliases, so i gave it no name

Q_FRC ($4C4F) keeps its Star Wars name and description but in this game it holds the wave type 0-3 (probots, walkers, TIE fighters, asteroids): it indexes enemy_name_msg, the manual sections at LB169 and the jump tables at LB109 and LB1BD
the Executor picture is identified by message $2C and its shape only (a 1300 wide wedge hull). it sits at $2B70 in pseudo ROM set 0 (source LBCEC) and at $298E in set 2 (source LC202)

B0:AC99 and B0:ACAC: DO1GAS speaks (SPKSIZ, PMREB) at zero shields only when Q_FRC is 2 or more and (SPKSIZ, SPKELE) at one shield only when Q_FRC is under 2. i could not tell why the two tests are opposite. the carried comments about R2 there are Star Wars'
